_meta.title: E&E Character Generator — Oracle of Book-Truth Assertions
_meta.doctrine: Each entry is one rules fact the generator must honor, harvested from the printed books and Adam's rulings ledger (v8.5.4_Notes.md cut log). status 'checked' = the battery implements an executable test; 'declared' = recorded truth awaiting an implemented check (honest debt, not silence). Sources cite HH/GMG/FF pages and §cut-log sections.
_meta.usage: node battery.mjs runs every checked entry against the real generator, headless.

entries.rule: A fresh boot of the generator produces zero console errors.
Taking the Supernatural Mutation feat confers the Mutant racial template (isMutantTemplated).
Reaching 10+ total MP confers the Mutant template; 9 or fewer does not (different, not Mutants).
Classification tracks the Mutant RLM: floor(totalEarned/10) — Minor 0 / Moderate 1 / Major 2 / Mega 3+.
A tier's spell_levels band gates only the CEILING: 0-level powers purchasable at every tier.
Catalog Buff tags use '; Buff'; the stamp recognizes them; 'includes X as Buff' partials never stamp.
A Buff-tagged super-power stands perpetually: its wired crunch applies with no invocation.
A Null Power Field suppresses perpetual Buffs (Su); Ex tree values stand back up where applicable.
An invoked (augmented) casting supersedes the standing base; rest clears the casting and the perpetual resumes.
Voluntary suppression toggle exists; reactivation costs no PP.
computeDR surfaces power-sourced DR (perpetual Stoneskin = 10/adamantine; Iron Body = 15/adamantine).
At equal DR value, '/—' outranks any typed bypass for the dashboard headline.
Universal x/− from class-level progression stacks into one pool; item/mutation/power x/− are separate best-in-situation instances.
Energy Immunity grants one FREE Energy Resistance Tree talent (no slot), THEN immunity to every held resistance — floor of two immunities.
The granted Resistance talent is exempt from the Talent slot budget.
Removing Energy Immunity removes its granted talent; hand-picked Resistances survive.
Titanic Strength = a second instance of Mangler's hardness function ONLY: Advanced tier doubles to ignore 40 / break DC −16.
The ×4-carry/+1-size riders are per-talent (HH p.263) and are NOT doubled by the echo.
Mangler supersedes the base Ignore Hardness values (5/−2, 10/−5, 20/−8 by tier); under NPF the Ex tree (2/−1 per tier) stands back up.
Carrying numbers at or beyond 10,000 lb display in short tons rounding down (10,000→'5 tons', 256,000→'128 tons'); below stays in lb.
Each passive Strong super-talent grants ×4 carry (multiplicative) and +1 effective size; Supreme Effort's rider applies only while performing one.
Unnatural Prowess/Resilience per ML: +floor(ml/2) BA, +floor(ml/3) Def, +2·ml SP (Tech-0), +ml·(5+Con) HP, +floor(ml/2) saves.
Owning 2+ powers of a suite discounts further suite buys by a flat −1 MP (floor 1, never stacking; tier cap tests BASE cost).
Maximum skill ranks = character level + 4.
Printed MP prices are canon with NO formula fallback; rung-priced families stamp the rung bought.
Improved Grapple adds +4 to computeGrapple with provenance.
Reckless Offense: +2 on attack ROLLS (Grapple included), −4 AC; never Base Attack, no iterative minting.

Evasion/Uncanny Dodge unify through evasionTier/uncannyDodgeTier across class features and Fast Hero talents; ANY second distinct source upgrades to Improved (Adam's ruling 2026-10-06: instances of Evasion stack).
No rendered Sheet ever displays NaN or 'undefined' for any legal character.
qdBespokeBuild validates every ladder entry at its own level; illegal ladders refuse rather than build.
Every feat, talent, cybernetic and mutation whose text claims a number moves at least one engine output when granted — or is listed in grant_audit_allow.json with a reason.

entries.source: HH mutation entry (Tentacle); found by GRANT-AUDIT 2026-10-06
entries.rule: Tentacle: +4 mutation bonus on grapple checks — unconditional, so it belongs in computeGrapple (the v8.71.0 Improved Grapple doctrine). Currently a note only.

entries.source: HH p.252 (feat) + mutation entry; found by GRANT-AUDIT 2026-10-06
entries.rule: The Ultra Immune System mutation materializes the Ultra Immune System feat (prereq waived; bonus typed as mutation), and the feat adds a conditional Fort entry vs poison/disease/radiation. Neither half is wired; the feat's magnitude awaits Adam's book check.

Charm: competence = Charismatic Hero level (min 1) on Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Handle Animal and Intimidate — a CONDITIONAL flag: only vs targets indifferent or better, never unfriendly or hostile (the book's letter, restored). Fast-Talk flags its own situation (deceiving anyone); Silver Tongue alone is standing.
Fast-Talk: Charismatic Hero level as a competence bonus on Bluff/Diplomacy/Gamble checks to con or deceive — surfaced on the skill rows (conditional entry).

entries.source: HH p.87 (Monk 3 Wild Talent: 2 PP) + Psi Implant (HH p.339); found by GRANT-AUDIT 2026-10-06
entries.rule: Wild Talent — by feat, Monk 3, or Psi Implant — grants 2 PP and makes the character psionic; the Psi Implant's materialized record names the Psi Implant as its source.

entries.source: HH pp.297, 308 (tool & skill kits); found by GRANT-AUDIT 2026-10-06
entries.rule: Every equipment skill bonus is keyed to a real skill row (Craft (Chemical), Perform (instrument), Repair) so it reaches the Sheet; basic electrical/mechanical kits grant no bonus (they only remove the no-tools penalty) — the deluxe kits carry the +2.

Wearable gear occupies its body slot (Back/Belt/Eyes/Vest, capacity-checked against magic items); devices activate only when worn and push gear Boons that stand through a Null Power Field; removal ends them; carrying gear never aids the super-strong; Boost's Bane (10% on ending) outlasts rest.

Removable weapon accessories (laser sight, scopes, suppressors, illuminator) mount only on eligible weapons and never stack with their integrated gadget twins (one per kind); removing the weapon frees them.

entries.source: HH p.294 + FF animal entries; Adam 2026-10-06 (v9.4.0)
entries.rule: A purchased animal is an OWNED companion (FF stat card, no class progression) tied to its Gear item: buying adds the card, removing either removes both; the donkey-or-mule purchase picks its species.
